purpose: Finite declarative research-space authority; not a candidate wave and not an economic result.
instantiation_rules: Dimensions are allowed families, not a Cartesian grid and not candidate identities.
Each economic candidate must prospectively choose a finite exact specification before its outcome is opened.
Breadth across materially distinct mechanisms and structures precedes micro-tuning.
No large lookback, threshold, hold or parameter grids are authorized by this space.
Causal ML requires temporal training, no random temporal shuffle, no future normalization, frozen features/target/preprocessing/retraining schedule and Cloud-portable final representation.
Asset availability, broker feasibility and data sufficiency must be established when an identity is instantiated; inclusion here does not assert availability.
